card.name: Computer program product in patent claims
card.fires_on: The word "product" (or "program") in the phrase "computer program product" inside patent claims. It also fires on title words in patent listings, such as "CONTROL PROGRAM" or "METHOD FOR DRIVING".

modes.label: Claim wording
modes.description: "product" or "program" in repeated "The computer program product as recited in" claim text.
modes.example: 10. The computer program<< product>> as recited in 11.

modes.label: Patent title lists
modes.description: Capitalised title words in lists of patent numbers and titles.
modes.example: IMAGE FORMING DEVICE AND CONTROL<< PROGRAM>>| |JP20082
